_why: dutchie.py's field names were asserted by NO test. If Dutchie renames one, every unit test stays green and production silently returns zero products - the exact failure mode that hid the category_blocklist and indica-flower bugs. This is the real field list from a live 5,350-row response, so a rename now fails a test instead of a customer.
_no_cost_data: Deliberately field NAMES only, no row bodies. unitCost/margin must never enter the repo (leak-guard discipline applies to fixtures too), and the parsing contract does not need values.

required_by_parser.strainType: Indica/Sativa/Hybrid/Indica-Hybrid -> Product.strain_type (the hyphenated values are why exact-match strain filtering missed 66 products)
required_by_parser.roomQuantities: per-room stock; ONLY the Sales Floor room is counted (_sales_floor_qty)
required_by_parser.quantityAvailable: total across rooms - NOT what we sell from
required_by_parser.unitPrice: shelf price. NOTE there is no field called 'price' - a parser looking for one finds nothing
required_by_parser.unitWeight: grams, reconciled against a weight token in the name
required_by_parser.unitCost: cost basis - NEVER leaves the budtender service (leak-guard)
